description: Entering into Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities with the objective of academic collaboration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- It has been recognized that it is essential to establish higher educational collaborations with Foreign Universities for the Sri Lankan Universities to climb up in global ranking and for internationalization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to enter into Memoranda of Understanding, between the Sri Lankan Universities and Foreign Universities as follows for a period of five years, was approved by the Cabinet.

Memorandum of Understanding between the Bhikshu University of Sri Lanka and the Mahamakut Buddhist University in Thailand, on conducting collaborative research, and academic workshops and conferences, with the objective of enhancing academic and cultural activities among Faculties and students.


Memorandum of Understanding between the Bhiksu University of Sri Lanka and the Nalanda Institute in Jakarta, Indonesia, with the objective of enhancing academic cooperation in the fields of education, research and community service, obtaining the expert knowledge of education specialists and lecturers, utilizing physical resources such as laboratories and libraries, developing human resources through training programmes including internship training and academic conferences and supporting curriculum development .


Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Colombo, Sri Lanka and the SGH Warsaw School of Economics, Poland, with the objective of conducting joint research and launching publications in mutually agreed areas, organizing joint conferences and workshops, facilitating staff and student exchanges and exchanging academic information and materials.
